name: Malšice (Czechia)
description: Four vertical stripes of red, white, red and white in the ratio 1:1:1:1, with three yellow eight-pointed stars one above the other in the hoist red stripe.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 22 October 2008 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
